posts.title: Toward a Transit Hierarchy of Needs
posts.description: The Aaron E. Henry Community Health Services Center operates demand response transit service in the Mississippi Delta region with 45 vehicles. The city of Gadsden, Alabama runs buses on four fixed routes, but not on weekends or after 3 P.M. The Chicago Transit Authority runs some of its heavy rail lines with no worse than 15-minute frequency, all day and night, on weekdays, weekends, and holidays.

posts.title: Using Arf for Route Planning Experimentation
posts.description: Last month, I used arf’s network modification capabilities to develop a small restructure of King County Metro’s transit network in Seattle. This change to routes 3 and 11 produced an access gain, while reducing the overall amount of service time expended.
